t:
The reports required under section 271 and section 272 shall present the reasons for each site, location, facility, and activity being declared or being removed from the declaration list and shall certify that—
    (1) each site, location, facility, and activity included in the list has been examined by each agency with national security equities with respect to such site, location, facility, or activity; and 
    (2) appropriate measures have been taken to ensure that information of direct national security significance will not be compromised at any such site, location, facility, or activity in connection with an IAEA inspection.

fable.w: The section prescribes the contents of reports and certifications, and the only review it mentions is examination by federal agencies with national security equities, which is intra-government coordination. The tempting reading is that agency examination or the reference to an IAEA inspection counts as outside consultation, but the IAEA is only mentioned as the inspecting body, not as a party consulted before a federal decision. No outside party is given a comment, hearing, advisory, or litigation role.
fable.s: each site, location, facility, and activity included in the list has been examined by each agency with national security equities

qwen_block.w: This section mandates the preparation of reports and certifications by federal agencies regarding national security sites. It does not require consultation with or participation from any entities outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, the public, or private companies). The 'agencies with national security equities' are federal entities, making this internal government coordination.
qwen_block.s: The reports required under section 271 and section 272 shall present the reasons for each site, location, facility, and activity being declared or being removed from the declaration list and shall certify that— (1) each site, location, facility, and activity included in the list has been examined by each agency with national security equities with respect to such site, location, facility, or activity; and (2) appropriate measures have been taken to ensure that information of direct national security significance will not be compromised at any such site, location, facility, or activity in connection with an IAEA inspection.

opus.w: The only review this section requires is by federal agencies with national security equities, and the reports it describes go to Congress. Both are inside the federal government. The IAEA inspection is something the government protects information against, not a way for outsiders to help decide what goes on the declaration list, so no party outside the federal government takes part in the decision.
opus.s: each site, location, facility, and activity included in the list has been examined by each agency with national security equities with respect to such site, location, facility, or activity
opus.b: The tempting reading is to call this participation because it mentions examination by "each agency with national security equities" and refers to an IAEA inspection. That reading fails. The agencies doing the examining are all federal, so that is coordination inside the government. The reports under sections 271 and 272 go to Congress, which is also inside the government. The IAEA conducts inspections, but nothing here has it advise on or take part in the decision to put a site on the declaration list or take it off.

qwen_chat.w: The section requires federal agencies to examine sites and certify that national security measures are in place. All actors mentioned (agencies with national security equities) are inside the federal government. There is no requirement to consult with states, tribes, the public, or other outside entities. Intra-agency coordination is explicitly excluded from the definition of participation.
qwen_chat.s: each site, location, facility, and activity included in the list has been examined by each agency with national security equities with respect to such site, location, facility, or activity
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "each agency with national security equities" implies coordination between different federal agencies, which could be seen as participation. However, the definition explicitly states that consultation or coordination *between* federal agencies is intra-governmental and does not count as participation. Furthermore, the text describes internal agency examinations and certifications, not interaction with outside parties.
